zh-CN.guide.title: 竞选攻略：当前局势推演
zh-CN.guide.limits: 以下包含无随机波动的模型推演和有出处的逐题路线。实测记录不代表成功概率；请按当前可见选项和本局设置自行作答、访问。
zh-CN.guide.baseline: 当前无波动预测：{votes} 张选举人票；过半门槛 {target} 张；普选票 {popular}%。
zh-CN.guide.method: 排序优先考虑竞争州的选举人票：接近平手的州影响更大，再以普选票改善打破同分。下列“加权指标”仅用于比较策略，不是额外选举人票。
zh-CN.guide.recommended: 优先考虑：屏幕上的第 {position} 个选项
zh-CN.guide.alternative: 其他选择：屏幕上的第 {position} 个选项
zh-CN.guide.effect: 选择后预测 {votes} 张选举人票；加权指标 {score}；普选票变化 {popular} 个百分点。
zh-CN.guide.visit_now: 当前可以访问。下表比较额外访问一次的效果，正数差距表示领先最强对手，负数表示落后。
zh-CN.guide.visit_later: 供下一次访问参考；回答本题后会重新计算。正数差距表示领先最强对手，负数表示落后。
zh-CN.guide.margin: 对最强对手差距（百分点）
zh-CN.guide.gain: 差距 {margin} 个百分点；指标 {score}
zh-CN.guide.history: 历史解读：选项旁的“典故”沿用已校订、有来源的离线说明。游戏加分不等于历史上正确、可行或符合该人物立场；本面板按游戏效果排序，不替历史人物作价值判断。
zh-CN.guide.formula: 使用原版计票函数的独立副本，在克隆数据上把随机项设为零。计入当前候选人、搭档、难度、既有答案、访问、全国和州加成及议题匹配。一次访问原始加成为 0.005 × max(0.1, 州基础乘数) × 访问倍率；它不是直接增加 0.5 个百分点。采用原版各州票数分配规则。
zh-CN.guide.future: 这是逐题即时建议，不是对整局所有分支求出的全局最优解。未来题目、最终计票的额外波动、特殊事件和分票取整都可能改变结果。竞争州指标采用 2 个百分点的平滑尺度，该尺度是攻略排序参数，不是游戏真实波动率；比例分票州按得票份额加权。
zh-CN.guide.advanced: 高级竞选模式：计入当前已经生效的州加成和访问倍率，但不预测本轮后续筹款、广告、游说、时间分配或对手行为。
zh-CN.guide.locked: 本剧本有锁定结果的州；攻略保留这些结果，访问未必能够改变它们。
zh-CN.guide.unavailable: 当前数据无法可靠推演，已停止给出推荐；游戏仍可照常进行。
zh-CN.guide.no_visits: 这个内置剧本没有州访问环节，因此不提供访问建议。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_general: 常规胜选（选择成就可改为专项引导）
zh-CN.guide.achievement_compatible: 当前组合可尝试：{names}。还需满足模式、难度和回答条件。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_none: 没有专属项目；可查看跨年／特殊目标
zh-CN.guide.achievement_select_hint: 选择一个成就，下面的答案和访问顺序会随目标重排。选择不适用的目标可查看替代总统／搭档。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_combination: 此年份／总统／搭档不符合目标；请查看下方替代组合。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_settings: 当前模式、难度或 BIG SHOT 状态不符合条件；需要按要求重新开局。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_missed: 本局已错过必要回答；继续赢选举也不能补回此条件，需要重新开局。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_open: 未发现硬性阻碍，继续按目标推进；不代表必然可达。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_unlocked: 当前浏览器存档已解锁此成就。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_goal_exact: 目标：本人恰好 {target} 张选举人票；不要盲目追求更多票。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_goal_min: 目标：本人至少 {target} 张选举人票。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_goal_max: 目标：本人最多 {target} 张选举人票；本目标需要压低己方结果。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_goal_win: 目标：获胜，并满足下面列出的附加条件。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_goal_finish: 目标：按资格完成整局并进入最终结算，无需保证胜选。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_goal_votes: 目标：本人普选票至少 {target} 票；不是固定比例。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_goal_popularLead: 目标：本人普选票高于主要对手；僵局结局不符合。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_goal_winLosePopular: 目标：赢得选举，但普选票低于主要对手。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_goal_winPopular: 目标：同时赢得选举与主要对手间的普选票比较。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_goal_state: 目标：赢下指定州；不必同时赢得全国选举。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_goal_florida: 目标：佛州前两名差距小于0.5个百分点，且全国榜首最多294张选举人票。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_lose_states: 必须在这些州排第二，不能获胜：{states}。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_difficulty: 倍率必须不高于 {value}；普通难度为0.97。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_special: 特殊非合规分支：普通公平局不检查此项。BIG SHOT须在进入答题前启用；不要混刷其他普通成就。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_years: 已记录306／232的年份：{years}。每个指定年份分别推进。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_answer_now: 下一步必须选择下面这个回答 #{id}，已放在本题建议首位。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_answer_pending: 后续须选择回答 #{id}；出现对应题目时优先选择以下原文。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_blocked: 此目标当前不能继续推进；下面保留常规胜选建议，不将它冒称本成就路线。可换组合或按原因重开本组合。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_ranking: 专项排序先保必要回答，再按票数／指定州等目标比较当前预测；每次作答与访问后更新。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_combinations: 建议优先尝试的总统／搭档组合
zh-CN.guide.achievement_evidence: 优先列出已有实际解锁记录的组合，再参考普通胜选单种子结果；记录次数不是成功概率。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_baseline: 单种子参考：本人 {ev} 张选举人票；不是已验证的本成就路线。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_untested: 仅确认组合兼容；缺少此模式／难度的合规成就对照数据。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_uncertainty: 无波动局部预测不能保证最终达标。精确票数、第二名、普选逆转、随机分支与单局成就优先级须以最终结算和实际存档为准。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_recorded: 此年份的306／232已经记账；请改玩尚未记录的年份。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_ended: 本局已经结束，存档尚未解锁此项。请核对结局条件和成就优先级，再决定重开或换搭档；当前策略不保证成功。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_planning: 胜选／高票目标还对已载入的剩余题目做有限整局规划，假定后续选项可用；遇到分支会按实际可见选项重算。显示的票数仍是当前局势预测，不是最终保证。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_disabled: 成就引导已关闭。下方保留普通胜选建议，不再按成就目标规划；重新开启可恢复之前的目标。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_route_coverage: 已映射本组合 {count}/{total} 道题；按问题和答案ID匹配。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_route_tested: 本地测试记录：{success}/{total} 局解锁；这是已测样本，不是成功率保证。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_route_unverified: 社区来源已核对，尚无本地完整通关验证。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_route_source_changed: 当前英文数据与路线记录不一致，已停用固定路线。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_route_settings: 该路线的测试设置：{mode}模式，难度系数 {difficulty}。当前设置不同，使用一般推演。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_route_deviated: 此前答案或访问已偏离这条路线，当前使用一般推演，不能沿用路线测试成绩。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_route_gap: 原帖未明确本题答案，当前建议来自一般推演。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_route_step: 本题优先列出社区路线对应的答案。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_route_rng: 原作含随机波动；社区成功案例不能保证本局必达。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_route_none: 本组合尚无已收录的固定社区路线，当前使用源码条件与模型推演。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_verified_pair: 实际解锁 {success}/{total} 局；模式 {mode}，难度系数 {difficulty}。{route}
zh-CN.guide.achievement_procedure_destiny: 依次完成2020、2016、2012、2000、1988、1976和1964。每年本人取得232或306票即可，不必复刻整张地图。可使用比例分配；保持普通成就资格。已记录的年份无需重复。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_procedure_what: 在同一浏览器、同一地址下，正常完成2016a共100局；不要求获胜。不要清除本地存档或切换端口。开启BIGSHOT或高级模式的对局不计入普通成就。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_procedure_whychance: 这是原版作弊彩蛋：在开局菜单依次输入BIGSHOT并回车两次，按提示确认，再完成一局。此状态下普通成就不计入；关闭攻略开关不会关闭原版BIGSHOT。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_procedure_stillAlive: 这是原版作弊彩蛋。菜单开启BIGSHOT后，选择1968华莱士／勒梅；用原版作弊面板将难度系数设为41，依本目标建议作答，争取535票。华盛顿特区没有该候选人的选票，不能取得538票。系数41也不能保证乱选答案成功；已有一次527票的失败记录。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_route_year_tested: 此年份达标记录：{success}/{total}局；须集齐七年才解锁整项成就。不是成功概率。
zh-CN.guide.achievement_verified_year_pair: 此年份实际达标{success}/{total}局；模式{mode}，系数{difficulty}。{route}

en-US.guide.title: Campaign guide: current-state forecasts
en-US.guide.limits: Includes zero-noise projections and sourced answer routes. Replay records are not success probabilities. Choose answers and visits yourself using the current visible options and settings.
en-US.guide.baseline: Current zero-noise projection: {votes} electoral votes; majority threshold {target}; popular vote {popular}%.
en-US.guide.method: Ranking prioritizes electoral votes in competitive states, with greater weight near a tie; popular-vote improvement breaks ties. The weighted index compares strategies and is not an additional electoral-vote count.
en-US.guide.effect: Projected electoral votes after choosing: {votes}; weighted index {score}; popular-vote change {popular} percentage points.
en-US.guide.visit_now: A visit is available now. This compares one additional visit; a positive margin means leading the strongest opponent and a negative margin means trailing.
en-US.guide.visit_later: For your next visit; recalculated after this answer. A positive margin means leading the strongest opponent and a negative margin means trailing.
en-US.guide.history: Historical context: Chinese “典故” buttons retain the reviewed, sourced offline notes. A gameplay bonus does not establish historical correctness, feasibility, or fidelity to a candidate’s beliefs. This panel ranks game effects, not historical judgments.
en-US.guide.formula: An independent copy of the original vote calculator runs on cloned data with zero random terms. It includes the candidate, running mate, difficulty, previous answers and visits, national/state effects and issue alignment. The original visit bonus is 0.005 × max(0.1, base state multiplier) × visit multiplier; it does not directly add 0.5 percentage points. Original state electoral allocation rules are retained.
en-US.guide.future: This is immediate, question-by-question advice, not a globally optimal solution across every branch. Future questions, extra final-count noise, special events and allocation rounding may change outcomes. The competitive-state index uses a 2-percentage-point smoothing scale for ranking, not the game’s actual volatility; proportional states are weighted by vote share.
en-US.guide.advanced: Advanced campaign mode: current state bonuses and visit multiplier are included, but later fundraising, advertising, lobbying, time allocation and opponent actions are not forecast.
en-US.guide.locked: This scenario has states with locked results. The guide preserves these results; visits may not change them.
en-US.guide.unavailable: The current data cannot be projected reliably. Recommendations are withheld; the game remains playable.
en-US.guide.no_visits: This native scenario has no state-visit stage, so no visit advice is shown.
en-US.guide.achievement_general: General victory (select an achievement for objective advice)
en-US.guide.achievement_compatible: Compatible with this pairing: {names}. Mode, difficulty and answers still matter.
en-US.guide.achievement_none: No dedicated objectives; check general or special objectives
en-US.guide.achievement_select_hint: Select an achievement to rerank answers and visits. Select an incompatible objective to see alternative pairings.
en-US.guide.achievement_combination: This year/president/mate does not fit. See alternative pairings below.
en-US.guide.achievement_settings: Mode, difficulty or BIG SHOT status does not qualify; restart with the required settings.
en-US.guide.achievement_missed: A required answer was missed. Winning later cannot repair it; restart this objective.
en-US.guide.achievement_open: No hard blocker found; continue toward the objective. Reachability is not guaranteed.
en-US.guide.achievement_unlocked: Already unlocked in this browser save.
en-US.guide.achievement_goal_exact: Target: exactly {target} electoral votes. More is not always better.
en-US.guide.achievement_goal_max: Target: at most {target} electoral votes. Reduce your result for this objective.
en-US.guide.achievement_goal_win: Target: win and satisfy all additional conditions below.
en-US.guide.achievement_goal_finish: Target: complete a qualifying run and reach final results; victory is not required.
en-US.guide.achievement_goal_votes: Target: at least {target} popular votes, not a fixed percentage.
en-US.guide.achievement_goal_popularLead: Target: beat the main rival in popular votes; a deadlock does not qualify.
en-US.guide.achievement_goal_winLosePopular: Target: win the election while losing the popular vote to the main rival.
en-US.guide.achievement_goal_winPopular: Target: win both the election and the popular-vote comparison with the main rival.
en-US.guide.achievement_goal_state: Target: win the specified state; national victory is not required.
en-US.guide.achievement_goal_florida: Target: Florida top-two margin below 0.5 percentage points and national leader at no more than 294 EV.
en-US.guide.achievement_difficulty: Difficulty multiplier must be at most {value}; Normal is 0.97.
en-US.guide.achievement_special: Special non-legitimate branch: ordinary fair runs do not check this. Enable BIG SHOT before questions; do not mix with ordinary achievements.
en-US.guide.achievement_years: Years with a recorded 306/232: {years}. Complete each required year separately.
en-US.guide.achievement_answer_now: Choose required answer #{id} now; it is ranked first below.
en-US.guide.achievement_answer_pending: Answer #{id} is still required. Choose this text when its question appears.
en-US.guide.achievement_blocked: This objective is blocked. Advice below is general victory advice, not an achievement route. Change pairing or restart with the corrected setup.
en-US.guide.achievement_ranking: Objective ranking prioritizes required answers, then current vote/state forecasts. It updates after answers and visits.
en-US.guide.achievement_evidence: Prioritizes combinations with actual unlock records, then one-seed ordinary-win baselines. Replay counts are not success probabilities.
en-US.guide.achievement_baseline: One-seed reference: {ev} EV for this candidate; not a verified achievement route.
en-US.guide.achievement_untested: Pairing compatibility only; no qualifying achievement comparison for this mode/difficulty.
en-US.guide.achievement_uncertainty: Local zero-noise forecasts do not guarantee success. Exact votes, second place, popular-vote inversions, random branches and unlock priority must be confirmed by final results and the actual save.
en-US.guide.achievement_recorded: 306/232 already recorded for this year; play a missing year instead.
en-US.guide.achievement_ended: This run ended without this unlock in the save. Check final conditions and achievement priority before retrying or changing mates; this strategy is not guaranteed.
en-US.guide.achievement_planning: Win/high-EV objectives also use bounded planning over loaded future questions, assuming their options remain available. Branches trigger replanning with visible choices. Displayed votes remain current-state forecasts, not final guarantees.
en-US.guide.achievement_disabled: Achievement coaching is off. Advice below uses ordinary victory ranking, with no achievement planning. Re-enable to restore the previous objective.
en-US.guide.achievement_route_coverage: Mapped {count}/{total} questions for this pairing by question/answer ID.
en-US.guide.achievement_route_tested: Local record: unlocked in {success}/{total} tested games; not a success guarantee.
en-US.guide.achievement_route_unverified: Community source checked; no local full-game verification yet.
en-US.guide.achievement_route_source_changed: Current English data differs from the route; fixed recommendations are disabled.
en-US.guide.achievement_route_settings: Route settings: {mode}, difficulty multiplier {difficulty}. Current settings differ; using general forecasting.
en-US.guide.achievement_route_deviated: Earlier choices/visits diverged; general forecasting resumes and route test results no longer apply.
en-US.guide.achievement_route_gap: The source does not specify this question; suggestions use general forecasting.
en-US.guide.achievement_route_step: The source route answer is ranked first for this question.
en-US.guide.achievement_route_rng: The original game includes randomness; community successes do not guarantee this run.
en-US.guide.achievement_route_none: No fixed community route collected for this pairing; using source conditions and model forecasts.
en-US.guide.achievement_verified_pair: Actual unlocks in {success}/{total} games; mode {mode}, difficulty {difficulty}. {route}
en-US.guide.achievement_procedure_destiny: Complete 2020, 2016, 2012, 2000, 1988, 1976 and 1964 with exactly 232 or 306 own electoral votes. The full map need not match. Proportional is allowed; keep ordinary achievement eligibility. Recorded years need not be repeated.
en-US.guide.achievement_procedure_what: Finish 100 eligible 2016a games in the same browser and origin; winning is unnecessary. Do not clear local storage or change ports. BIGSHOT or Sea to Shining Sea games do not count.
en-US.guide.achievement_procedure_whychance: This is a native cheat easter egg: at the starting menu, type BIGSHOT and press Enter twice, accept the prompts, then finish a game. Ordinary achievements are ineligible in this state; turning the guide off does not disable BIGSHOT.
en-US.guide.achievement_procedure_stillAlive: Native cheat easter egg: enable BIGSHOT at the menu, choose Wallace/LeMay in 1968, set the multiplier to 41 using the native cheat panel, then follow the objective advice for 535 votes. Wallace is absent from the DC ballot, so 538 is impossible. Multiplier 41 alone is insufficient: an arbitrary-answer replay earned only 527.
en-US.guide.achievement_route_year_tested: This year was recorded in {success}/{total} games; all seven years are required for the achievement. Not a success probability.
en-US.guide.achievement_verified_year_pair: Year recorded in {success}/{total} games; mode {mode}, difficulty {difficulty}. {route}
